title: Acceptance mapping (FR-3.2)
description: The implement-step completion artifact: maps each plan-phase acceptance clause id to >=1 concrete piece of collector-enumerated evidence {kind, id}. `kind` names the collector, `id` is the node/check that collector enumerates. `kind` is a CLOSED enum of registered collectors (v1: pytest only) — an evidence entry naming an unregistered collector is schema-invalid (rejected at load, never a runtime surprise), not a collector that silently 'parks closed'. The acceptance_gate proves citation + existence only; test sufficiency stays the spec-coverage review lens's job (G2).

phase.description: The plan phase id this mapping covers (e.g. "P2").

text.description: The clause text, copied from the plan for audit.

evidence.description: >=1 evidence entry per clause; each cites one collector-enumerated id.

kind.description: The collector namespace. CLOSED enum: v1 registers only `pytest`. Widening this enum requires implementing and registering that collector's plugin (side-effect-free enumeration + config contract) — until then the kind is load-invalid, with no declare-but-unimplemented path.

id.description: The id that collector enumerates (for pytest, a `pytest --collect-only` node id, e.g. "tests/unit/test_x.py::test_y").

deferrals.description: Optional deferral references ("Deferred to P<N>"). P2 only carries them; reconciliation against real phases is a P3 deliverable (FR-3.3).
